_notes: ศึกปราบ บทที่ 1 บ้านเกิด (docs/design/pve-campaign.md §3, SPEC-castle-battle §13). Side 1 is the stage's enemy, played by the paced bot (packages/sim/test/battleBot.ts). enemy.cards: a sect id (its disciples) or a list of card ids, with leader and sub among them; without a leader the list is a fixed hand. enemy.level: every enemy card at that level (casual stats, never normalized). mana.start: the player's start mana; fortBonus: mana the player gains the first time it takes each fort; enemyStart and enemyRegenPct: the enemy's start mana and regen as % of the normal rate. fortsAtPct: the fort layout. gimmicks (any of): castle (side enemy (default) or player: that castle starts at hpPct of its HP; over 100 reinforced) | waves (free enemy units: from sec, again every everySec, count units each starting tiles deep from its castle and 0.5 tiles further back each, a warning warnSec before each) | noCannon (neither castle may fire) | bloodMoon (enemy units deal dmgPct of their damage). stars: three goals, each needs the win (win | castleHp pct | under sec | total: every fort ours | kills n), the chapter's unless a stage sets its own; starNamesTh names them. rewards.win replaces progression.json matchRewards.win (a loss or draw pays matchRewards); rewards.firstClear is paid once per account on the first win: card | homeRole (collection.json homeRoleCards of the player's home sect) | eggPoints (a card already owned pays its tier's egg price instead). Stage i opens once stage i-1 is won. Balance: npm run sim:campaign (the paced bot on the collection the player owns at each stage, Lv1).
